answer_1.quote: Large language models (LLMs) have emerged as promising tools for automating various software engineering tasks... DARS enhances coding agents by dynamically re-sampling actions based on prior execution results.
answer_1.outputs: Code patches, reproduction scripts, and trajectory-based solutions for bug fixes

answer_2.quote: We evaluate model performance using multiple metrics. Resolve Rate (Pass@1) measures the fraction of instances fixed on the first attempt, while Pass@k represents the expected success rate within k attempts.

answer_3.quote: Finally, we introduce a trajectory selection pipeline leveraging proprietary and preference-optimized models to identify the most promising solution... We use off-the-shelf open and close source models as well as our custom supervised-fine-tuned models to choose the best trajectory based on custom rubrics.
